subject.title: fix(sessions): reconcile client-abandoned running sessions on restart

question: Does the lifecycle-generation boundary correctly fence every process-global embedded and reply-run registry consumer, including restart recovery and replacement races, before this P1 session-state change merges?
rationale: The required source and history inspection could not run, while the patch changes shared process-global ownership and the provided CI summary contains failed shards.

options.title: Complete owner review and proof

options.title: Pause pending targeted repair
options.body: Hold the PR if any registry consumer can still reach prior-generation state or if failed shards expose a regression.

recommendation.title: Complete owner review and proof
